description: Create a scheduled autonomous task for a bot. The instruction is a self-contained, natural-language directive the bot executes with its tools (find stale conversations, message contacts, schedule follow-ups, etc.). Sends are always screened against Do-Not-Contact, a per-run cap, and a no-repeat window.

config.description: Safety / execution config for the task.

approvalPhone.description: Admin phone (international format) to send the approval prompt to.

channelId.description: WhatsApp channel UUID to act on (defaults to the bot's primary).

dryRun.description: Simulate the run without actually sending messages.

maxActions.description: Hard cap on outbound actions per run (default 25).

noRepeatDays.description: Never re-message the same contact within this many days (default 14).

requiresApproval.description: Ask an admin on WhatsApp to approve before the task sends.

enabled.description: Whether the task is active (default true).

instruction.description: What the task should do, in natural language (self-contained; preserve any exact message copy verbatim).

schedule.description: Schedule payload matching scheduleKind. cron: { time: 'HH:MM', days?: number[] } (0=Sunday..6=Saturday; empty/omitted = every day). interval: { everyMinutes: number }. once: { runAt: ISO8601 string }. manual: {}.

scheduleKind.description: cron = recurring at a clock time (slot); interval = every N minutes; once = a single future moment; manual = only runs on demand.

timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. Africa/Lagos). Defaults to UTC.

name: neuron_create_task
title: Create Bot Task
